summary: XCF Global (Nasdaq: SAFX) filed an 8-K furnishing updated unaudited pro forma condensed combined financials for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and FY2025, tied to its proposed business combination first disclosed April 14, 2026 (and an S-4 filed June 15, 2025, amended July 14 and 27, 2026). The filing also references XCF's probable acquisition of Southern Energy and DevvStream under a Term Sheet. No purchase price, exchange ratio, premium, board recommendation, advisor, break fee or closing date is stated here; only Article 11 pro formas and Exhibit 99.1 are provided. Watch for definitive terms, S-4 effectiveness, shareholder vote and Nasdaq listing mechanics; arbitrage hinges on deal terms still undisclosed.
